conflicts.fact: Which lesson establishes the cohesion-tension/transpiration pull mechanism, and what the main force driving xylem water upward is
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says cohesion-tension and transpiration pull will be established in Lesson 3. Lesson 3 instead teaches root pressure as the cause of the dye rising and defers the topmost-leaf mechanism to Lesson 4. Lesson 4 says its content is translocation and defers transpiration to Lesson 5, yet its model step claims Lesson 3 added cohesion-tension forces. Lesson 7 says transpiration pull is the primary force and Lesson 8 says cohesion-tension; Lesson 3 says root pressure explains why the dye moved up against gravity.
